clue.text: Simplified house — official one's covered in lead

indicators.note: something covered in a material has that material wrapped all round it, so the lead goes outside

parts.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for lead
a ref is a referee, a sports official
one is A, the indefinite article; the 's is just 'is'

explanation.surface: A building inspector's report: a simple house where an official is wrapped up in lead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lead' is the metal, not leadership; its symbol PB wraps round REF and A.
explanation.definitionFit: A prefab is a factory-built house assembled quickly on site, a simplified kind of dwelling.

clue.text: One writer in debt matured

indicators.note: the writer and the one sit inside the word for debt

parts.note: being in the red means being in debt
one is the Roman numeral I
a pen is a writing instrument

explanation.surface: An author falls into debt and grows older and wiser.
explanation.definitionFit: Fruit that has ripened has matured fully; the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Offer a choice — e.g. in terms of frock?

definitions.text: Offer a choice — e.g. in terms of frock?

indicators.note: the choice word sits inside the outer letters
the terms of a word are its ends, its outer letters

parts.note: the little word or offers a choice between two things

explanation.surface: A dressmaker's puzzle: how might a frock give you options?
explanation.walkthrough: 'e.g.' marks this as one example of the whole clue: OR (a word that offers a choice) placed inside F and K, the ends of 'frock'. The whole clue also defines the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A road or path that forks splits in two, offering travellers a choice of routes.

clue.text: Beat up about hotel resident ignoring special bread

indicators.note: the reworked letters go round the shortened guest
beat up means battered out of shape, so the letters of beat are rearranged
ignoring means leaving out, so the letter for special is dropped

parts.note: a guest stays at a hotel

explanation.surface: Someone assaults a hotel guest, ignoring a special loaf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' rearranges BEAT into BATE, which goes 'about' GUET, GUEST with S taken out by 'ignoring'.
explanation.definitionFit: A baguette is a long thin French loaf, one particular kind of bread.

clue.text: Iron tracks suitable for Skimbleshanks?

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron
a railway line is a set of tracks

explanation.surface: Iron rails sound just right for a railway character.
explanation.walkthrough: Skimbleshanks is the Railway Cat in T. S. Eliot's Old Possum's Book of Practical Cats, so the iron tracks fit him.
explanation.definitionFit: Feline means catlike or befitting a cat, and Skimbleshanks is a cat.

clue.text: Anglo-Swiss painter to join heads of Literary Institute

parts.note: to fuse things is to join them together

indicators.note: the heads of words are their first letters

explanation.surface: A painter joins the leaders of a literary institute.
explanation.definitionFit: Henry Fuseli was a Swiss-born painter who worked in England, famous for The Nightmare.

clue.text: Boats record cold water on sea trips

parts.note: a log is a written record, as in a ship's log
C marks the cold water tap

indicators.note: trips here means stumbles, so the letters of on sea fall into a new order

explanation.surface: Boats log cold water on their voyages at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trips' looks like voyages but signals the anagram of ON SEA, making ANOES.
explanation.definitionFit: Log canoes are boats made from hollowed-out tree trunks.

clue.text: Woodworking tool to look bad? Good when held by sister

indicators.note: the sister holds the other pieces inside her

parts.note: a nun is a religious sister
to ail is to be unwell, to look poorly

explanation.surface: A carpentry question: does a tool look bad, and is it better in a nun's hands?
explanation.definitionFit: A nail gun drives nails into timber with compressed air, a power tool used in carpentry.

clue.text: Offerer of tips: 'A resort will have sweetheart coming back'

parts.note: a spa is a health resort

indicators.note: coming back means the term of endearment is read in reverse

parts.note: sugar is a term of endearment, like sweetheart

explanation.surface: Someone offering advice says a resort will bring back a lover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Offerer of tips' suggests an adviser or a waiter's customer; the tips are the edible spear ends of a vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: Asparagus is eaten for its tender spear tips, so it is a vegetable that offers tips.

clue.text: There'll be uproar with metal failing here!

definitions.text: There'll be uproar with metal failing here!

indicators.note: failing means breaking down, so the combined letters collapse into a new order

explanation.surface: An exclamation that there will be an outcry here if the metal gives way.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: armour plate is the metal whose failure would cause uproar.
explanation.definitionFit: Armour plate is the protective steel sheeting on warships and tanks; if it fails there is chaos.

clue.text: Composer to hold attention without piano say

indicators.note: without means lacking, so the musical letter is removed

parts.note: a gripping story holds your attention, so to grip is to hold attention
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly
say means for example, abbreviated e.g.

explanation.surface: A composer trying to hold the audience's attention without a piano.
explanation.definitionFit: Edvard Grieg was the Norwegian composer of the Peer Gynt suites.

clue.text: Bird alleged gone after struggle

indicators.note: struggle suggests wrestling things about, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A bird reportedly vanished following a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: The golden eagle is a large bird of prey found across the northern hemisphere.

clue.text: Island's number among the largest, in brief

indicators.note: the number sits among the letters of the short word for largest

parts.note: max is short for maximum, the largest

explanation.surface: An island's population counts among the largest, briefly put.
explanation.definitionFit: Manx means belonging to the Isle of Man, so it is the island's adjective, as in a Manx cat.

clue.text: All's aflutter in female set with appearance of gang member

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go inside the word for a female bird

parts.note: a hen is a female bird

indicators.note: aflutter means in a nervous flap, so the letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: a jelly that sets is said to gel

explanation.surface: A hen party in a flap at the sight of a biker gang member.
explanation.walkthrough: The S of 'All's' counts as fodder here rather than being a possessive; 'aflutter' rearranges those four letters before they go into the female bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hells Angel belongs to a notorious motorcycle gang.

clue.text: Wave's mostly inappropriate with delay

indicators.note: mostly means all but the last letter is kept

parts.note: undue means unwarranted or inappropriate
something late comes with a delay

explanation.surface: A complaint that a wave was badly timed and late.
explanation.definitionFit: To undulate is to move up and down in waves, a synonym for the verb wave.

clue.text: Story about one abandoning spirited Liberal behaviour

indicators.note: the untruth goes about the other pieces

parts.note: a story can mean a fib, a lie

indicators.note: abandoning means leaving behind, so the letter for one is dropped

parts.note: feisty means spirited and lively
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A tale of a spirited Liberal giving up his conduct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Story' is a fib here, not a narrative; 'abandoning' drops the one (I) from the word for spirited.
explanation.definitionFit: A lifestyle is the way a person lives and conducts themselves, their pattern of conduct.

clue.text: Lightweight showing resilience after head's zapped

indicators.note: the head of the word is zapped, so its first letter is deleted

parts.note: bounce means springiness or resilience

explanation.surface: A lightweight boxer shows resilience after a blow to the head.
explanation.definitionFit: An ounce is a small unit of weight, so it is a light weight.

clue.text: Article on stage performer not about missing finale in such venues

parts.note: the is the definite article

indicators.note: about is C, circa, and not means it is removed
missing its finale means the last letter is gone

parts.note: an actress performs on stage

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece on a stage actress who misses the finale in these venues.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing finale' drops the last S of ACTRESS and 'not about' drops C (circa), leaving ATRES.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatres are the venues where stage performers act, so they are such venues.

clue.text: Student enthralled by French singer (exotic dish)

indicators.note: someone enthralled is held captive, so the student sits inside the singer

parts.note: Edith Piaf was a famous French singer
L is a learner, a student driver

explanation.surface: A student captivated by a French singer, with a dish on the side.
explanation.walkthrough: L comes from the learner plates British learner drivers display.
explanation.definitionFit: Pilaf is a spiced rice dish from the Middle East and South Asia.

clue.text: Ultimately magical view involving connection, endless spiritual connection?

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word
involving means taking in, so the shortened link goes inside

parts.note: to eye something is to view it

indicators.note: endless means the final letter is removed

parts.note: a link is a connection

explanation.surface: A mystic's magical vista involving a connection, a never-ending spiritual bond.
explanation.definitionFit: Ley lines are supposed alignments of ancient sites believed to carry mystical energy between them.

clue.text: Payment received after game finishes early in part of England

indicators.note: after means the payment comes behind the shortened game
finishing early means the last letter is lost

parts.note: chess is a board game
hire is the payment received for the use of something

explanation.surface: Someone collects payment after a game ends early somewhere in England.
explanation.walkthrough: CHESHIRE is a county in north-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheshire is an English county, so it is a region of the country.

clue.text: On the move? Trek ending early in pub

indicators.note: the shortened walk goes inside the pub

parts.note: an inn is a pub

indicators.note: ending early means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a trail is a long walking route, a trek

explanation.surface: A trek cut short with a stop at the pub.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in train is under way or in progress, already moving forward.

clue.text: Hopelessness one encountered in a city in Alaska

indicators.note: the numeral is encountered within the city's name

parts.note: Nome is a city in Alaska
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone meets despair in an Alaskan city.
explanation.definitionFit: Anomie is a sense of alienation and purposelessness when social norms break down, close to despair.

clue.text: Asian native behind Gulf concealing diamonds from old African country

indicators.note: behind means the native comes after the chasm

parts.note: an abyss is a gulf, a deep chasm

indicators.note: concealing means hiding away, so the card suit letter is removed

parts.note: an Indian is a native of India in Asia
D is the abbreviation for diamonds, the card suit

explanation.surface: An Asian behind the Gulf hiding diamonds from an African land.
explanation.walkthrough: Abyssinia is the old name of Ethiopia.
explanation.definitionFit: Abyssinian describes someone or something from Abyssinia, the former name of Ethiopia.

clue.text: Coach mostly involving men

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a stage is a stagecoach

explanation.surface: A coach trip that is mostly men.
explanation.walkthrough: A stag party is a British pre-wedding night out for the groom and his male friends.
explanation.definitionFit: Stag describes an event for men only, as in a stag night or stag party.

clue.text: Be credible with the evidence of arson?

parts.note: ash is what a fire leaves behind

explanation.surface: An investigator asks whether the arson evidence will convince.
explanation.walkthrough: An excuse that won't wash will not be believed.
explanation.definitionFit: To wash, in the idiom 'that won't wash', is to be believable or acceptable.

clue.text: Instruct chess body to back unknown

indicators.note: to back means to go in reverse, so the federation's initials run backwards

parts.note: FIDE is the world chess federation
y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: A command telling the chess authority to support an unknown player.
explanation.definitionFit: To edify is to instruct or improve someone morally or intellectually.

clue.text: Preserve horse transfixed by disease killing off tail

indicators.note: transfixed means pierced through, so the shortened illness goes inside

parts.note: a mare is a female horse

indicators.note: killing off the tail means the last letter is removed

parts.note: a malady is a disease

explanation.surface: A horse pierced by a disease that kills off its tail.
explanation.definitionFit: Marmalade is a fruit preserve made from citrus, usually Seville oranges.

clue.text: Get rid of bad service in performance? Not entirely

indicators.note: the faulty serve goes into the shortened deed
not entirely means the last letter is cut

parts.note: a deed is a performance of an act
a let in tennis is a serve that must be retaken

explanation.surface: A tennis player is told to get rid of bad serves in a match, partly.
explanation.definitionFit: To delete something is to remove or erase it, to get rid of it.

clue.text: Inscrutable figure manipulated information about hard times

indicators.note: the slanted information goes about the hard letter

parts.note: spin is information slanted by spin doctors
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard
x is the multiplication sign, times

explanation.surface: An enigmatic figure spun information about hard times.
explanation.walkthrough: 'manipulated' looks like an anagram signal but SPIN is the synonym for the whole phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sphinx of Egyptian and Greek myth is an enigmatic, inscrutable figure.
